description: This file contains unit tests for the DataReaderFactory class, verifying its ability to create appropriate DataReader instances based on version information, including tests for unknown, version 1, and version 2 data readers.

classes.name: DataReaderFactoryTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing DataReaderFactory creation methods.

methods.name: shouldFailToCreateDataReaderForUnknownVersion
methods.description: Test that DataReaderFactory returns nullptr when an unknown version number is provided.

methods.name: shouldCreateDataReaderV1
methods.description: Test that DataReaderFactory creates a DataReaderV1 instance when version 1 is specified.

methods.name: shouldCreateDataReaderV2
methods.description: Test that DataReaderFactory creates a DataReaderV2 instance when version 2 is specified.
